$comment: An overlay is a folder of your own mods that ledgr's install.sh deploys with it. This one is the repo owner's: his tab bar (my-tabs) hosts ledgr's writer instead of ledgr's host block, and his pane header (my-pane) draws the chip instead of ledgr-pane. A mod that imports ./ledgr/*.js gets ledgr's engine files copied into its ledgr/ folder.
